evidence.citation: Artifact: "Re-run every case, each with a fresh blind agent... Sweep the live checkout after every run and remove any leaked changes... Have a separate fresh judge evaluate each artifact... Re-run the failed case, and any borderline case, 2–3 times to report a pass rate... Compare before/after results... and verify that the revision did not regress previously passing cases."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The required work is tied to validating the revised completion rule across all cases, protecting isolation and checkout integrity, checking reproducibility/pass rate on the failed or borderline cases, and confirming no regression on previously passing cases. Under the supplied bar, those are necessary controls rather than materially unnecessary execution work.
